ShortDescription.Value: Auto Clean deathcare or tweak it with Funeral Director

Publish.LongDescription:
## New Funeral Director added
Two modes:
### Option 1: Auto Clean - Removes dead citizens instantly when they are waiting for a hearse. - Great for death-waves and notification spam.
### Option 2: Funeral Director (Self Manage) Tune deathcare values: - Processing rate - Fleet size (max hearses per facility) - Cemetery storage multiplier
## Features - Toggle on/off without restarting the game. - No Harmony or Reflection (more reliable on patch days). - Safe to remove any time. Uncheck both checkboxes turns off the mod. - Disable other hearse mods to avoid conflicts! - Two options are mutually exclusive (use either Auto clean or self manage). - 11 languages
## Support and Feedback - If the mod works for you, give it a Like! - Feedback: GitHub / Forums / Discord.
## Credits - River-Mochi: author - Thanks to Wayz, creator of the original Magical Hearse - Necko1996: testing, screenshots - yenyang: technical consultant
## How it works - If the citizen is flagged as dead and needs transport, it's cleaned up. Looks like magic but the secret is flags. - Mod does not stop death - it's just very fast corpse cleanup. - Great for your next zombie apocalypse.
Publish.ChangeLog: * Added Funeral Director mode (Self Manage) with 3 sliders and reset button. * Auto Clean and Funeral Director are mutually exclusive. * Refactor Auto Clean logic for improved performance.
